# Agentropix-SIFT

> Agentropix-SIFT is a local, CLI-driven, bio-agentic Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) triage engine for the SANS SIFT Workstation. A deterministic Trinity Loop (Architect -> 7-agent Swarm -> Critic) drives 72 MCP tools (16 of them SIFT forensic wrappers) over one FastMCP server, correlating findings on a quorum blackboard and emitting a cryptographically sealed, schema-validated JSON triage report -- in minutes, on the local host, with no LLM ever in the halt/convergence path.

Canonical facts (governed by docs/08-reference/canonical-facts.md): 72 MCP tools; 16 SIFT forensic wrappers; 4,464 tests; disk recall 72/72 (100%); memory recall 108/118 (91.5%); Python 3.12+.

Repository: https://github.com/galvangabriel-web/agentropix-mcp  ·  License: MIT  ·  All numeric claims are governed by Canonical Facts.
